verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. O LORD, You showed favor to Your land; You restored the captivity of Jacob.
verses.textZh: （可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）耶和華啊，你已經向你的地施恩，救回被擄的雅各。

verses.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽，遮蓋了他們一切的過犯。（細拉）

verses.text: You withdrew all Your fury; You turned away from Your burning anger.
verses.textZh: 你收轉了所發的忿怒和你猛烈的怒氣。

verses.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Your indignation toward us to cease.
verses.textZh: 拯救我們的神啊，求你使我們回轉，叫你的惱恨向我們止息。

verses.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?
verses.textZh: 你要向我們發怒到永遠麼？你要將你的怒氣延留到萬代麼？

verses.text: Will You not Yourself revive us again, That Your people may rejoice in You?
verses.textZh: 你不再將我們救活，使你的百姓靠你歡喜麼？

verses.text: Show us Your lovingkindness, O LORD, And grant us Your salvation.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你使我們得見你的慈愛，又將你的救恩賜給我們。

verses.text: I will hear what God the LORD will say; For He will speak peace to His people, to His godly ones; But let them not turn back to folly.
verses.textZh: 我要聽神─耶和華所說的話；因為他必應許將平安賜給他的百姓─他的聖民；他們卻不可再轉去妄行。

verses.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, That glory may dwell in our land.
verses.textZh: 他的救恩誠然與敬畏他的人相近，叫榮耀住在我們的地上。

verses.text: Lovingkindness and truth have met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.textZh: 慈愛和誠實彼此相遇；公義和平安彼此相親。

verses.text: Truth springs from the earth, And righteousness looks down from heaven.
verses.textZh: 誠實從地而生；公義從天而現。

verses.text: Indeed, the LORD will give what is good, And our land will yield its produce.
verses.textZh: 耶和華必將好處賜給我們；我們的地也要多出土產。

verses.text: Righteousness will go before Him And will make His footsteps into a way.
verses.textZh: 公義要行在他面前，叫他的腳蹤成為可走的路。
